About.title: Why Lankio
About.subtitle: Hi, I'm Shehan — the Full-Stack Developer & AI Solutions Specialist behind Lankio.

founder.intro: I focus on building ultra-fast Next.js web applications, custom WordPress sites, and practical AI tools — backed by clear direct communication, craft quality, and European reliability.

About.missionBody: I help businesses replace sluggish or outdated websites with fast, modern digital experiences — paired with matching brand identities. No recycled bloated templates passed off as custom work, and no unnecessary monthly retainers.

FAQ.title: Everything you need to know.
FAQ.subtitle: Have questions about working together, pricing, or templates? Here are the answers.
FAQ.ctaSubtitle: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Feel free to write directly to me.

items.q: How does working with a solo developer compare to an agency?
items.a: You communicate directly with me—the engineer writing your code. No account managers, no hidden handoffs, faster response times, and lower overhead costs passed on to you.

items.q: How long does a typical project take to finish?
items.a: Template customizations are typically ready within 1 to 2 weeks. Custom web application and dynamic development projects usually range between 3 to 6 weeks depending on feature complexity.

items.q: Do I need technical knowledge to manage my site after launch?
items.a: Not at all. Every site includes a tailored CMS or easy management setup, along with direct training so you can edit content, text, and images effortlessly.

items.q: What happens if I need support or updates after launch?
items.a: Every project includes post-launch support. I also offer flexible ongoing retainer plans for technical maintenance, SEO updates, and system improvements.
